message.content:
The point \((7,-2)\) lies on the line, since  
\[
\frac{-12(7)+74}{5}=\frac{-84+74}{5}=-2.
\]

The line has slope
\[
-\frac{12}{5},
\]
so a direction vector parallel to the line is
\[
(5,-12).
\]
Its length is
\[
\sqrt{5^2+(-12)^2}=\sqrt{169}=13.
\]
Thus a unit direction vector is
\[
\left(\frac{5}{13},-\frac{12}{13}\right)
\]
or its opposite.

For \(x\le 7\), moving from \((7,-2)\) along the line must decrease \(x\). Therefore the direction vector should be
\[
\mathbf d=\left(-\frac{5}{13},\frac{12}{13}\right).
\]

The answer is \(\boxed{\begin{pmatrix}-\frac{5}{13}\\[2pt] \frac{12}{13}\end{pmatrix}}\).
